description: This file is a server-side route handler for the Invoice detail/edit page in a SvelteKit project, implementing load functions, actions for updating, canceling, sending, marking paid, and downloading invoice PDFs.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches invoice data, accounts, contacts, organization settings, and templates, transforms data into structured form for page rendering.

methods.name: actions.update
methods.description: Handles updating invoice data via PUT request, including CRM relationships and line items.

methods.name: actions.cancel
methods.description: Cancels the invoice and redirects to the invoice list.

methods.name: actions.send
methods.description: Marks the invoice as sent via POST request.

methods.name: actions.markPaid
methods.description: Records payment details, marking the invoice as paid.

methods.name: actions.downloadPdf
methods.description: Fetches the invoice PDF from Django backend, authenticating via JWT stored in cookies, returns PDF data as base64 string.
